zh: 熵源：由噪声源、可选调节组件与健康测试共同构成的组件。
噪声源：熵源乃至整个随机比特发生器的安全之根。
raw data：数字化后的噪声源输出。
min-entropy：本建议采用的最坏情形不确定性度量。
health tests：分为启动检测、连续检测与按需检测三类。
conditioning component：可选的熵调节部件，其最窄内部宽度记为 nw。
en: Entropy source: the component made of a noise source, an optional conditioning component and health tests.
Noise source: the root of security for the entropy source and for the whole random bit generator.
Raw data: the output of the digitised noise source.
Min-entropy: the worst-case unpredictability measure this Recommendation uses.
Health tests: start-up tests, continuous tests and on-demand tests.
Conditioning component: the optional entropy-conditioning part, whose narrowest internal width is denoted nw.
